messages:
claire: Quick plan: small dev-focused demo -> instant 150-token credit + 3 lean templates. Measure 3-day active lift.
devin: Sounds good. Can we A/B template vs no-template? Also consider 150 vs 400 token split if traffic allows.
priya: Events needed: demo_signup, seed_issued, template_applied, first_call_24h, active_3d. Include utm and campaign_id.
leo: Creative: 3 headlines to test on organic post. I'll draft visuals.
marco: Ops: landing + Calendly, deep-link to console route. Promo-bot, schedule demo next Tue.
promo-bot: demo_event created -> 1735630000; reminders="48h,1h".
de vin: Cohort assignment: hash(email)%100<50 -> control else treatment. Seeds toggled by second hash bit. I'll push snippet.
priya: Benchmarks: baseline active_3d ~12%. Hypothesis templates+150 -> +3pp. Need ~200/users per arm for power.
marco: Anti-abuse: block disposable domains, cap seeds per domain, company_size filter.
claire: Timeline: landing & creative 36h, signup endpoint 48h, templates 36h, analytics 72h. Proceed if ~250 signups first week.
priya: I'll build minimal dashboard: signups/day, template_use_rate, first_call_24h, active_3d.
claire: Great. I'll post this brief in #launches and assign tasks. Thanks team :rocket:
